name: Moire
description: Two combs of fine bars leaning apart by a degree more in every column, beating into moiré across the canvas.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 22%; top: -20%; width: 11%; height: 140%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transform: rotate(@calc(@x * 5)deg); transform: rotate(@calc(@x * 5)deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 62%; top: -20%; width: 11%; height: 140%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transform: rotate(@calc(@x * -5)deg); transform: rotate(@calc(@x * -5)deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
